GoogleSyncSettings.title: GoogleSyncSettings
GoogleSyncSettings.description: Permanently persisted Google Apps Script Web App URL and Google Sheet Tab Name for a user.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

webAppUrl.description: Deployed Google Apps Script Web App URL.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the settings document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the settings document was last updated.

SavedNote.title: SavedNote
SavedNote.description: Permanent notepad entry storing text, URLs, or reference content that cannot be deleted.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

label.description: Optional short label or title for the saved note.

content.description: Saved text, URL, or pasted content.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the note was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the note was last updated.

/users/{userId}/settings/{settingId}.description: Per-user permanent Google Sheets sync configuration (Web App URL and Sheet Tab Name).

/users/{userId}/notes/{noteId}.description: Per-user permanent notepad entries storing pasted text and URLs without deletion.
